title: Lucidcraft
description: This is a mod that's against making sense. Explore the kalanite world and discover some weird items...
body:
This mod is centered around the kalanite ore, a new ore that can be found in the overworld. with this new matirial you can craft a portal with blocks of kalanite and a flint and kalanite to go to the Kalanite World.

With Kalanite you can craft a Kalanite Table, a new crafting station with new recipes.

By progressing in the mod, you can get useful items that are like items that are in the vannila game but a little off...

These items can either give you passive effect, active effect or be used in other ways. You can get these items only from breaking Enlightened Essence Blocks (they are like lucky blocks). 
<details>
<summary>Kalanite Table recipes</summary>
items; result; arcana effect on the recipe

- 5 Kalanites; Kalanite tools with powerful enchants; type of tool.
- Quartz in top slot, 4 Kalanites; Kalanite Crystal; gamble for number of Kalanite Crystals.
- Bucket of Talanatite Sap in top slot, 4 Kalanite Crystals; Sapped Kalanite Crystal; gamble for number of Sapped Kalanite Crystals.
- 5 Sapped Ingots; Sapped Kalanite Crystals tools with very powerful enchants; type of tool.
- Netherite Upgrade in top slot, 4 Sapped Kalanite Crystals; Sapped Upgrade; gamble for number of Sapped Upgrades.
- Rotten Flesh in top slot, 4 Kalanites; Kalanite Zombie Spawn Egg; gamble for number of Kalanite Zombie Spawn Eggs.
- 5 Essence Blocks; 5 Enlightened Essence Blocks; gamble for number of Enlightened Essence Blocks.
</details>

<details>

- Pocket Wandering Trader | Invisibility in off-hand
